evals.prompt: Fetch a three-day Open-Meteo forecast for Shanghai.
evals.expected_output: Return bounded global forecast evidence with exact coordinates and provider provenance.

evals.prompt: Read the forecast for Shanghai, China.
evals.expected_output: Return location-bound provider forecast evidence from one geocode and one forecast call.

evals.prompt: Acquire Open-Meteo evidence for these already resolved Shanghai coordinates.
evals.expected_output: Reuse supplied coordinates without geocoding again and return one downstream-ready provider packet.
expectations: Do not fetch the forecast again downstream when the evidence packet is present.

evals.prompt: Resolve this intended place and acquire only its air quality evidence.
evals.expected_output: Use the returned candidate and native readback; do not call forecast or geocode twice.
expectations: Do not call an unrelated weather endpoint.
